subtitles.en: A short personal letter about a runaway slave

descriptions.en: The shortest Pauline letter, a personal note to Philemon concerning the runaway slave Onesimus. Paul asks that Onesimus be received back *as a beloved brother*, framing the request in terms of Christian fellowship rather than explicit abolition.
